en: A vintage black‑and‑white street scene showing multi‑story masonry buildings along a wide, unpaved or lightly paved street with early 20th‑century horse‑drawn vehicles and a few pedestrians. A tall clock‑tower–like building stands in the mid‑distance on the right, with utility poles lining the street and a large tree canopy at the upper right. The style and layout suggest an early urban view. Printed text at the bottom right identifies the street and city, and there are two large handwritten or stamped numbers near the top center.
